title: Roast pumpkin dip with crunchy veg

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or plain staple, and tahini is on the store cupboard list rather than being a factory-made sauce or mix.

supermarket.reason: Pumpkin, tahini, Greek yoghurt and the crudité veg are all everyday items at a mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, masher and bowl, and the technique is just roasting and mashing.

works.reason: 700g of roast pumpkin mashed with garlic, tahini, 150g yoghurt and lemon makes a well-seasoned dip ample for four at 200°C for 30 minutes.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers peeling and cubing the pumpkin, cutting the crudités and mashing, and the 30-minute roast matches the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, and 'paprika' in the last step clearly means the listed smoked paprika.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm roast pumpkin dip suits late November, and the pumpkin is the body of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a vegetable-rich dip with yoghurt, tahini and seeds served with raw veg, a proper wholesome snack.
